verdict.rationale: MX documents official first-party SDKs, a React Native SDK and a Web SDK, but they only embed the Connect Widget. The evidence shows no official client libraries for the Platform API itself; the published OpenAPI spec is a building block for generating clients, not an SDK. Missing for 10: official Platform API client SDKs in common languages, SDK reference depth (install, versioning, method docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
